During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]],<ref name="Extrapolation">{{TOR dates|1}} As Crew Skill Trainers are first accessible for all classes in Act I, meaning the Underworld Training Skill mission "Stolen Masterpieces" is first accessible during the events of Act I. Thus, this article assumes that the mission was completed during the Cold War in 3643 BBY.</ref> the companion of an individual delivered artwork stolen from the [[Museum of Abstract Ingenuity]] to an '''art collector''' on [[Antar 4/Legends|Antar 4]].<ref name="TORcite">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Underworld Trading|Stolen Masterpieces}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The art collector was first mentioned in the Crew Skill mission "Stolen Masterpieces", in [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]]' [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TORcite" />
